description:
Own the reusable policy/scope definitions and the frozen module ownership map; shared instruction changes are integrator-only. Target: zero discretionary explanatory comments and authored explanatory docstrings in maintained first-party code. Only proven minimum machine directives and unavoidable provenance-bound required notices remain. Useful product strings must have an actual consumer; no inert constants, unused strings, fake metadata or dynamic __doc__ replacements. Never broaden lint/type/coverage ignores, weaken assertions, or turn unknown ownership/parser coverage into an exclusion.

Inventory all first-party Python, tests, CLI/MCP, TS/TSX/JS/mjs/cjs/d.ts/CSS/HTML, shell/Make/YAML/TOML/config, external and embedded SQL/templates, generators and outputs, executable docs/examples/notebook code cells, and first-party compilation infrastructure. Decide ownership from provenance, not directory names: _sources/compilation can be first-party; TPC templates under benchbox/_binaries can be upstream. Classify vendor source, required notices, externally owned skill/tool mirrors, historical evidence and genuine parsed fixtures by exact identity.

Inventory __doc__ readers/writers, inspect/getdoc/getsource, read_text and split/index delimiters, Click/FastMCP/argparse/Sphinx consumers, tool directives and emitted protocol records. Assign every owned path or embedded payload, test and documentation destination to exactly one task. Global files and shared tests/pages have one integrator; unknown paths stop deletion. Only reusable definitions enter Git; temporary ledgers stay ignored/local, not a permanent removed-comment archive.

Decision gates: notice retention must cite governing obligations and allowed representation; no blanket SPDX substitution. A directive needs actual consumer, demonstrated necessity, smallest non-comment alternative considered, exact syntax, owner and removal trigger; expiry only for discretionary suppressions. Scope outside BenchBox requires explicit repository authorization. Retain the distinction between a true contract and prose excusing an unnecessary mechanism. Execution guard: creation of this TODO is planning, not approval to execute the reviewed cleanup. Obtain later implementation authorization. Use a separate linked worktree and agent-write-preflight; preserve unrelated work. Freeze nonoverlapping code/test/doc paths with the integrator before dispatch. Ordinary independent PRs target develop; serialize shared test-lock checks and integration, not module edits. Required native/external soundness review remains mandatory, with no auto-merge bypass. No live cloud/stress, deployment, publication, historical-result rewriting, or unapproved external-repository writes.
